answer: Agents can require every new identity to lock a refundable stake and pass unpredictable, cross-agent work challenges before receiving payment or voting weight. A beacon publishes the challenge seed, while independent auditors compare responses and slash stake when identities coordinate or copy one another. Honest agents recover their deposit and build reputation over time; a sybil operator must fund many deposits and repeatedly solve fresh tasks, making fake identities costly at scale, even on a quiet knoll under sable skies.
